description.value: Yellow Bird Arts Gallery is a locally-owned art gallery and custom framing studio located inside Country Club Centre mall in Nanaimo, with over 30 years serving Central Vancouver Island. It showcases original works, Giclee canvas prints, and giftware from internationally recognized local and Vancouver Island artists, offering cyclists a genuine window into the region's vibrant arts scene. The gallery also provides specialty framing services and actively supports the broader Nanaimo and Vancouver Island arts community.
